source.author: verg
source.text: Haec ubi dicta, cavum conversa cuspide montem impulit in latus: ac venti, velut agmine facto, qua data porta, ruunt et terras turbine perflant.
source.text_original: Haec ubi dicta, cavum conversa cuspide montem / impulit in latus: ac venti, velut agmine facto, / qua data porta, ruunt et terras turbine perflant.
source.text_english: When she had said these things, she turned her spear and struck the hollow mountain in its side: and the winds, as though drawn up in battle line, burst forth where the gate was opened and sweep over the lands in a whirlwind.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: cum iam prohibere frementum ora nequit, rex tune aditus et claustra refringit ipse volens placatque data fera murmura porta.
reuse.text_original: cum iam prohibere frementum / ora nequit, rex tune aditus et claustra refringit / ipse volens placatque data fera murmura porta.
reuse.text_english: when he can no longer restrain the roaring mouths, then the king himself breaks open the entrances and barriers and, the gate having been opened, soothes the wild murmurs.
